source.notes: arch-009 (A4 hierarchical chunks). Log-linear attention: a hierarchy of dyadic level states with per-level scales — H = Σ_level exp(segsum(g)) ∘ mask_level, o = (H ∘ qkᵀ)·v. NOT a softmax mask (H can be 0/negative); a linear-attention-like full-matrix form distinct from the canonical single-state K2 law (sweep verdict). The hierarchical construct_H_matrix/segsum/level-mask construction is the typed transform; level_scales frontend and the streaming/chunked partial-chunk state (LogLinearAttentionState) are residual. Verified against fla/ops/log_linear_attn/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/log_linear_attention.py.

params.axis: A4 hierarchical: dyadic level states + per-level scales (full-matrix reference form)
params.note: hierarchical K2 level state, not single-state

coverage.notes: The PUBLIC dyadic_banked_state op (a bank of K2-matrix states with the carry-cascade promote/reset lifecycle, decay-forward form) reproduces the pinned naive_log_linear_attn (fp32, <1e-3) across shapes incl. partial dyadic blocks (T=7,13,24); it also matches the disjoint dyadic-block decomposition and the full-matrix layer. The earlier divergence was an off-by-one (level l reads bank slot l-1), now fixed. Reference-tier only: the shared mixer is one structural family (009 + 046 differ only in frontend), so no native branch per the two-client gate; the pinned chunked *streaming* kernel (partial-chunk carry) remains the residual native schedule. hierarchy-active invariant + gradients in tests/test_architectures_a4.py.
